title: My Friends
text:
My friend Lucia is very kind. She is funny and she always makes me laugh. She is also very smart. She helps me with my homework.

My brother Tomas is shy. He does not talk a lot in class. But he is very honest. He always tells the truth.

questions.text: How is Lucia described in paragraph one?
What does Tomas do in class?
options: He does not talk a lot

questions.text: Why does the writer like Lucia?
options: She helps the writer and makes the writer laugh

questions.text: What kind of person is Tomas probably?
options: a person who is very loud
a person who is always angry

vocabulary.definition: nice and caring towards other people
does not feel comfortable talking to other people
